manifest.description: Shambling zombie, well rotten: hunched forward, arms reaching out, torn rag shirt with a blood stain, faded jeans, mottled yellow-brown decaying skin with bone showing through the forearm, cheek and ribs, sunken glowing eyes, patchy dark hair. Top-down 3/4 view, 8 headings, 6-frame shamble where the legs drag in turn and the arms sway (the torso stays planted, so nothing jumps).
